finding.what: Caption 15 says 16 developers from 102.0 s while the stage readout still counts 5, 10, 15; the 16 lands at 104.6 s, 0.2 s before the caption leaves.
finding.why: All 16 dots in by 103.0 s gives the counted 16 a 1.8 s hold under its own caption (counts land with their caption).

finding.what: Caption 16 says 246 issues from 105.0 s; the readout ticks 29, 135, 230 and reaches 246 only at 108.8 s, 2 s before the forecast caption.
finding.why: Landing the last issue column at 107.0 s halves the caption lead and holds 246 for 4 s before the 24 % appears at 111 s.

finding.what: In the measured side view the believed-after and forecast ghost frames are near-invisible next to the baseline line; the 20 % pin reads as pointing at the column face, so the belief (below the line) and the measurement (above it) are not two visible levels.
finding.why: Full accent mix makes the believed level a distinct line below the baseline, so the gap belief vs stopwatch is seen, not only captioned.

finding.what: Frame lines (baseline, forecast, believed-after) are 1.6 wide and vanish at 480 px; at phone width they are gone.
finding.why: A heavier line keeps the three levels legible at thumb and phone size; check next round that it does not read as a chart axis.

finding.what: During M1 (34-44 s) the 5,179 readout dims to 0.6 and is barely readable at thumb size; the invariant (same count) should be visible while the boxes travel.
finding.why: A lighter dim keeps 5,179 readable through the move (I2 visible on stage), still subordinate to the moving marks.

finding.why: Dimming the agents row further keeps it as context only, so the developers wall is the one lit object.
